name: Ivan Matveyevich Vinogradov
note: Proved the ternary Goldbach conjecture for sufficiently large odd integers (1937)

name: J. G. van der Corput
note: Van der Corput's method for exponential sums; foundational for the circle method

name: Theodor Estermann
note: Goldbach-Estermann theorem; early progress on the ternary problem

name: Arnold Walfisz
note: Siegel-Walfisz theorem on primes in arithmetic progressions

name: Hua Loo-Keng
note: Hua's lemma; founded the Chinese school of analytic number theory

name: Yu. V. Linnik
note: Linnik's theorem, the dispersion method, and the Linnik constant

name: Karl Prachar
note: Primzahlverteilung (1957), the standard reference on prime distribution for two generations

name: Askold Ivanovich Vinogradov
note: Bombieri-Vinogradov theorem on average prime distribution

name: Wang Yuan
note: Wang (1+4) result; key contributor to the Chinese school of additive prime number theory

name: Chen Jingrun
note: Chen's theorem (1+2): every sufficiently large even integer is the sum of a prime and a number with at most two prime factors. The closest result to Goldbach

name: Anatoly A. Karatsuba
note: Analytic number theory, exponential sums, and the Karatsuba multiplication algorithm; advisor to a major Russian school

name: Hans-Egon Richert
note: Sieve Methods (with Halberstam); the standard reference
